description: A muted faded teal-blue knee-length wool tunic over a natural cream linen long-sleeved shirt, restrained grey tablet-woven trim at the collar and cuffs, a sturdy plain dark-brown leather belt, dark olive-brown wool trousers, beige lower-leg wraps and dark-brown soft leather shoes. Clean practical early medieval Scandinavian landowner clothing of modest prosperous quality. No fur war gear, armor, weapons, head covering, crowns or heraldic emblems.
